meta.description: Reviewed latitude/longitude for the bus stops the site lists. 12 stops were added and 3 were upgraded by hand after scripts/geocode_stops.py ran (see manualAdditions below); the unresolved/rejectedByRouteGeometry counts below still describe that automated pass only, not the manual additions.
meta.licence: Stop coordinates are copied from openly published datasets: arkodeepg/calcutta-transport and murmusuvash2-wq/busjatri-open-data (ODbL 1.0 (c) OpenStreetMap contributors; GeoNames CC BY 4.0; Wikidata CC0). Entries fetched with --osm are (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
sources: OpenStreetMap / GTFS / GeoNames / Wikidata / India Post PIN
rules: A coordinate is copied from a source, never interpolated or averaged.
A match found through an abbreviation or a dropped noise word is capped at 'medium'.
A gazetteer or fuzzy match is 'review': check it in stop_coordinates_review.csv.
Coordinates outside 21.0-27.5 N / 86.0-90.0 E are dropped as name collisions.
A coordinate the route chains contradict is rejected: a bus cannot be 60 km from its previous stop.
An unresolved stop is absent, not estimated. The ride screen says so.

manualAdditions.description: Entries added by hand on top of scripts/geocode_stops.py's output, to work through next step/MISSING_COORDINATES.csv. Each was looked up against a real published map source (OpenStreetMap-derived listings, GeoNames, Wikipedia/Wikidata, or a specific business address) and sanity-checked against the before/after stops on its busiest route. Sources and notes are on each entry; see data/stop_coordinates_review.csv for the audit trail.
